name: @in-co-sandbox/workspace
description: Sandbox API client libraries for Node.js

scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json oxlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts && pnpm -r exec oxfmt --check .
scripts.format: oxfmt --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json oxlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts && pnpm -r exec oxfmt --write .
scripts.verify: pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm format:check && turbo run typecheck lint test
